subject: Azure Marketplace: publisher account identity checks + offer technical QA
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace@microsoft.com>, Azure Partner Ops <partnerops@microsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Patrick Riley <patrick@contoso.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace: publisher account identity checks + offer technical QA

Hi team,

We're preparing to publish the Redwood Inference "Dedicated Inference" SaaS offer for Contoso (deal RDW-ACCT-9874). Before we submit the offer draft we want to confirm the publisher account identity steps and the technical validation items that typically block certification. Can you confirm the minimum artifacts and the preferred format for each?

What we have ready to share (attached):
- publisher-identity-proof.pdf (company registration + authorized sig)
- redwood-offer-manifest.json (offer metadata draft)
- contoso-usage-projection.xlsx (customer consumption estimate for co-sell planning)

Specific asks:
1) Is the publisher identity proof PDF sufficient or do you need notarized docs / government ID for the primary contact?
2) Any mandatory security artifacts (SAML metadata, SOC2 snapshot) for the technical gate?
3) For the offer manifest, do you prefer the SKU mapping inlined or as a separate CSV?
4) Timeline: what is a realistic SLA for tech validation once we submit the draft (number of business days)?

Patrick from Contoso is on copy and available for any tenant-level proofs or verification calls. We want to align timelines so Contoso's procurement and our sales team can plan the co-sell kickoff.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
Attachment stubs: publisher-identity-proof.pdf, redwood-offer-manifest.json, contoso-usage-projection.xlsx

From: Azure Partner Ops <partnerops@microsoft.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace@microsoft.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: publisher account identity checks + offer technical QA

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the summary and the attachments — helpful. Quick answers inline:

1) Publisher identity: the PDF is fine for initial review, but we require a notarized Articles of Incorporation or equivalent for final publisher activation. If you can provide a notarized copy within 10 business days we can proceed to full account activation.

2) Security artifacts: for the tech gate we need either a current SOC 2 report (redacted is okay) OR a completed security questionnaire + evidence for the listed controls. If you do not have the SOC 2 yet, submit the questionnaire and the SAML/SP metadata (if you support SSO).

3) Manifest/SKUs: we prefer SKU mapping as a separate CSV attachment named skus.csv; the JSON manifest is fine as supplemental. Please include pricing tiers per SKU and billing unit.

4) Timeline: after we receive complete artifacts (identity + tech) the typical validation window is 7-10 business days. If there are gaps, we will open a validation ticket and prioritize based on partner tier (you are in the Silver partner queue).

Action items for Redwood:
- Submit notarized publisher proof (pdf)
- Provide SOC2 or completed security questionnaire and SAML metadata
- Add skus.csv with pricing tiers

We're copying the Azure Marketplace certification engineer and will open a portal ticket (we'll share the ticket ID once created). If you want a short sync to walk through the manifest we can do a 30-min slot tomorrow afternoon.

Regards,

Lina Huang
Azure Partner Operations
partnerops@microsoft.com

--
Note: ticket will be opened after the notarized doc is received

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Partner Ops <partnerops@microsoft.com>, Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace@microsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Patrick Riley <patrick@contoso.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: publisher account identity checks + offer technical QA

Lina — thanks for the clear guidance.

We can move quickly on this:
- We'll produce a notarized publisher proof and upload to the portal by EOD Friday (17 Sep).
- Attached is an updated offer manifest (redwood-offer-manifest.json) and a provisional skus.csv (see attachment). Pricing tiers are marked as preliminary; Ben will follow up on final E2E pricing.
- We don't yet have SOC 2. We'll complete the Azure security questionnaire and provide SAML metadata for the Redwood Console (we support SSO via SAML).

Patrick — can your IT team provide the tenant-level verification (subscription ID or a validation token) so Azure can validate co-sell routing? If easier, we can schedule a 15-min call tomorrow with Lina to share the tenant proof.

Next steps (owners):
- Jonas: notarized publisher proof upload (ETA 2027-09-17)
- Ben Carter: finalize pricing SKUs and upload final skus.csv (ETA 2027-09-20)
- Marissa Cole: complete security questionnaire draft and own SOC2 remediation plan (ETA initial draft 2027-09-22)

Thanks — will update the HubSpot deal with the timeline.

Jonas

--
